metric_contracts.clustering: source case/family; repeat scans do not add cases
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Show total catalog, eligible subset and unresolved mapping; unknown is not negative.

metric_contracts.denominator: frozen resolved applicable positive/negative case universe
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: No whole-warning or whole-file label substitution; provide unscored counts.

metric_contracts.denominator: frozen applicable properties of the same endpoint type
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Unknown implication is not a detector false positive.

metric_contracts.clustering: source family; stage omissions are paired
metric_contracts.denominator: applicable references in the same population, if normalized
metric_contracts.numerator: size of union(all stages) minus union(all except s)
metric_contracts.unit: verified instance within one compatible population
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Never create an overall percentage from incompatible property/vulnerability units.

metric_contracts.clustering: source case/object/resource; pair counts are dependent
metric_contracts.denominator: supported comparable pairs in each ground-truth relation class
metric_contracts.numerator: same-instance disagreements and different-instance disagreements separately
metric_contracts.unit: independently resolved finding pair of the same relation type
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Non-identical IDs alone do not prove different vulnerabilities; related-to is not equality.

metric_contracts.clustering: source family; repeated policies do not add instances
metric_contracts.denominator: verified positive instances represented in B0
metric_contracts.numerator: instances with zero retained supported witnesses
metric_contracts.unit: verified positive instance represented before policy
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Exclude negative reference cases from true-case retention; show unresolved witness links.

metric_contracts.clustering: seven current negative SAST source cases, not eleven independent defects
metric_contracts.denominator: false warnings in the fixed baseline cohort
metric_contracts.scope: Eleven reviewed false SAST warnings from seven source cases. There are no false declarations in the 15-case extension.
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Undefined when no false warnings; no global FPR claim.

metric_contracts.denominator: true warnings in the same baseline population
metric_contracts.scope: The 73 inherited resolved native observations, separately by population. Do not pool the 15 additional literal declarations into this endpoint.
metric_contracts.unit: resolved native warning at its frozen assertion scope
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Separate literal declaration correctness from exploitability.

metric_contracts.clustering: finding nested in source family; repeated output not new truth
metric_contracts.numerator: abstentions, invalids, timeouts, missing replies and action differences separately
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Retain findings on invalid, missing or abstaining replies; never silently repair.

metric_contracts.clustering: execution block; all repeat values retained
metric_contracts.denominator: attempted/processed cases only where throughput defined
metric_contracts.numerator: wall seconds, CPU seconds, sampled RSS, cgroup counters, tokens and output volume
metric_contracts.unknown_policy: Keep startup/reset/acquisition separate; measured RSS and cgroup memory are not interchangeable.
